The Shop

Old-School Craft, a Dapper Finish.

Tucked into the brick-and-leather rooms on East Colfax, Alfani’s is a barbershop in the proper sense — vintage chairs, sharp blades and barbers who take the time to get your look exactly right.

Whether it’s a tight skin fade, a beard sculpted to the millimetre, or a hot-towel shave you can sink into, you leave looking like the best-dressed version of yourself. That’s the standard at every chair.

Good to Know

Frequently Asked

Do you take walk-ins?

Yes — walk-ins are always welcome. Booking ahead is the surest way to lock in your time and your preferred barber, especially on weekends.

How do I book an appointment?

Use the booking form on this page, call us at (720) 379-6471, or tap the chat assistant in the corner and it’ll set you up in seconds.

Do you do beard work and shaves?

Absolutely. We offer beard shaping and lineups, plus classic hot-towel straight-razor shaves for the full traditional experience.

What does a cut cost?

Our menu lists starting prices — a signature haircut starts from $35 and a skin fade from $40. Final pricing depends on length, style and any add-ons. Call for a quote on combined services.

What payment do you take?

Cash and all major cards. Tips are always appreciated but never expected.
